@@U01291@@
If ’'m any judge of such things, his mind wandered wildly as he gasped his last. “T never had time to kill,” said he; “first to get children for her, and then bread for them all— bread in the very broadest sense—and then not have time to eat my share in peace.”

@@U01293@@
He forgot, did he, my loyalty to him, my love, slaving away for him day and night?

@@U01295@@
Not so, no, never, he thought of you fondly. Said he: “When I sailed out from Malta, I prayed hard for wife and children; and then Heaven blessed us: we captured a Turkish vessel that had in its hold a treasure of great Sultan himself. Bravery’s reward then came due, and I got my share.”

@@U01297@@
What's that? What? Where? Did he bury it?

@@U01299@@
Who knows where the four winds have blown it? One day as he strolled through Naples, a lovely young miss took him to her heart. She showed him so much love and loyalty that he felt it till the day he died.

@@U01301@@
Oh! The scoundrel! The wretch! Stealing from his own children, he did! No misery, no poverty could check his scandalous life!
translation:
@@U01291@@
如果对这些事情有任何判断的话，当他咽下最后一口气时，他的思绪在疯狂地游荡。 “我从来没有时间去杀戮，”他说。 “首先是为她生孩子，然后为他们所有人提供面包——最广泛意义上的面包——然后就没有时间安静地吃我的那份了。”

@@U01293@@
他忘记了，是不是，我对他的忠诚，我的爱，为他日夜操劳？

@@U01295@@
不是这样，不，从来没有，他深情地想着你。他说：“当我从马耳他出航时，我为妻子和孩子祈祷；然后上天保佑我们：我们捕获了一艘土耳其船只，里面装着伟大苏丹本人的宝藏。勇敢的奖赏到了，我也得到了我的那一份。”

@@U01297@@
那是什么？什么？在哪里？他把它埋了吗？

@@U01299@@
谁知道四风把它吹到哪里去了？有一天，当他在那不勒斯漫步时，一位可爱的小姐把他深深地吸引住了。她向他表达了如此多的爱和忠诚，以至于他直到去世的那一天都感受到了这一点。

@@U01301@@
哦！恶棍！这个可怜虫！他偷了自己孩子的东西，他确实这么做了！任何痛苦、任何贫穷都无法阻止他可耻的生活！
